svg.title: C12-M05-F2: Dependency control points
svg.desc: A chain from approved index through lock file, hashed install, SBOM, vulnerability gate and licence check to a signed release and daily re-scanning.
svg.text: approved index --> lock file + hashes --> install (--require-hashes)
--> SBOM --> SCA gate (pip-audit exit code) --> licence check
--> signed release with SBOM (Module 7) --> daily re-scan of SBOMs
Figure C12-M05-F2. Controls from package source to post-release monitoring.
